# cairn doctor claude-code

Verify Claude Code can discover the configured Cairn MCP server, start it, call `status`, and find the five expected hook entries without mutating config.

## Help

Usage: cairn doctor claude-code [OPTIONS]

Options:

                              lookups
      --vault <NAME_OR_PATH>  Active vault: name from registry or filesystem path (overrides

      --server-name <NAME>    Claude Code MCP server name to verify [default: cairn]
